hints.title: Virtual Dense Remapping Sampling
hints.text: Compact valid numbers into a contiguous range [0, M-1] by remapping blacklisted values in that prefix to valid numbers in the tail.

hints.title: Tail Swap Hash Remapping
hints.text: Let M = n - len(blacklist). Put blacklist numbers in a set. Iterate over blacklisted items strictly less than M, mapping each to an available non-blacklisted item from [M, n-1].

hints.title: Blacklist Remapping Blueprint
hints.text: M = n - len(blacklist). b_set = set(blacklist). last = n - 1. For b in blacklist: if b < M: while last in b_set: last -= 1; map[b] = last; last -= 1. In pick(): r = randint(0, M - 1); return map.get(r, r).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Initial remapping takes O(B) time; each pick executes in strict O(1) random lookup time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rejection sampling can loop indefinitely if blacklist occupies a significant fraction of N.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table stores remappings only for blacklisted items under M, requiring O(B) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of two-pointer tail swapping to compress whitelist into [0, M-1].

solutions.approach: Tail Value Remapping to Contiguous Prefix
